problems.why: Ateji for the Portuguese loanword carta. The alignment succeeds only because the three kanji happen to spell the sound (歌=カ, 留=ル, 多=タ), so the sound credited to 歌 is not wrong; but the word is purely phonetic writing, not a 歌-compound, and it sits in the カ list next to 歌手/歌謡/短歌 as if it were one. Same class as 硝子/ガラス, which the spec puts in irregular.
